name: Credit Transfer Transaction 66
definition: Provides further details specific to the individual transaction(s) included in the message.

CreditIdentification.name: Credit Identification
CreditIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by a sending party, to unambiguously identify the credit instruction within the message.

BatchBooking.name: Batch Booking
BatchBooking.definition: Identifies whether a single entry per individual direct debit transaction or a batch entry for the sum of the amounts of all transactions within the group of a message is requested.|Usage: Batch booking is used to request and not order a possible batch booking.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Further specifies the type of transaction.

TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.name: Total Interbank Settlement Amount
TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

SettlementTimeIndication.name: Settlement Time Indication
SettlementTimeIndication.definition: Provides information on the occurred settlement time(s) of the payment transaction.

InstructingAgent.name: Instructing Agent
InstructingAgent.definition: Agent that instructs the next party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InstructedAgent.name: Instructed Agent
InstructedAgent.definition: Agent that is instructed by the previous party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

IntermediaryAgent1.name: Intermediary Agent 1
IntermediaryAgent1.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than one intermediary agent is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 identifies the agent between the DebtorAgent and the IntermediaryAgent2.

IntermediaryAgent1Account.name: Intermediary Agent 1 Account
IntermediaryAgent1Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 1 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent2.name: Intermediary Agent 2
IntermediaryAgent2.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If more than two intermediary agents are present, then IntermediaryAgent2 identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent1 and the IntermediaryAgent3.

IntermediaryAgent2Account.name: Intermediary Agent 2 Account
IntermediaryAgent2Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 2 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

IntermediaryAgent3.name: Intermediary Agent 3
IntermediaryAgent3.definition: Agent between the debtor's agent and the creditor's agent.||Usage: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then it identifies the agent between the IntermediaryAgent 2 and the CreditorAgent.

IntermediaryAgent3Account.name: Intermediary Agent 3 Account
IntermediaryAgent3Account.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the intermediary agent 3 at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

CreditorAgent.name: Creditor Agent
CreditorAgent.definition: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor.

CreditorAgentAccount.name: Creditor Agent Account
CreditorAgentAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor agent at its servicing agent to which a credit entry will be made as a result of the payment transaction.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Financial institution that receives an amount of money from the financial institutional debtor.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry will be posted as a result of the payment transaction.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate financial institution to which an amount of money is due.

InstructionForCreditorAgent.name: Instruction For Creditor Agent
InstructionForCreditorAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, provided by the initiating party, and intended for the creditor agent.

DirectDebitTransactionInformation.name: Direct Debit Transaction Information
DirectDebitTransactionInformation.definition: Provides information on the individual debit transaction(s) included in the message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

UltimateCreditorGuideline.definition: UltimateCreditor may only be present if different from Creditor.

IntermediaryAgent2Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent2 is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent3Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent3 is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent1Rule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent1 is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

IntermediaryAgent1AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent1Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent1 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent2AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent2Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent2 must be present.

IntermediaryAgent3AccountRule.definition: If IntermediaryAgent3Account is present, then IntermediaryAgent3 must be present.

CreditorAgentAccountRule.definition: If CreditorAgentAccount is present, then CreditorAgent must be present.

TotalInterbankSettlementAmountRule.definition: If CreditInformation/TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then all occurrences of DirectDebitTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementAmount must have the same currency as the currency of CreditInformation/TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.

TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule.definition: If TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then it must equal the sum of all occurrences of DirectDebitTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementAmount.

InterbankSettlementDateRule.definition: If InterbankSettlementDate is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/InterbankSettlementDate is not allowed.

PaymentTypeInformationRule.definition: If PaymentTypeInformation is present, then DirectDebitTransactionInformation/PaymentTypeInformation is not allowed.
